profile.name: OBI
profile.title: FULLSTACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER & ANIMATOR
profile.bio: I am an 18 year old student-athlete studying for my bs in cs and bioengineering at UMass Amherst, and an experienced developer with 9 years of specific expertise in ROBLOX Lua. Beyond Lua, I have extensive programming experience in Java, C#, Python, JS, and F#. I've worked on high-impact projects, including developing 'Metanoia' and Zombie Task Force (which reached 5.3M+ visits), and I have a strong background in competitive cs through numerous hackathons, including hackMIT, and game dev. My accolades include being the winner of the 2024 Congressional App Challenge in Massachussetts & a third place finish at HackMIT Blueprint.
